title: Aasman neela kyun hai?

beats.narration: Sunlight white dikhti hai, lekin kyun aasman neel hai?
beats.tts: Sunlight white dikhti hai, lekin kyun aasman neel hai?
beats.heading: Aasman neel hai? Kya ghaat?

beats.narration: Sunlight is actually all colours mixed together.
beats.tts: Sunlight is actually all colours mixed together.
beats.heading: Sunlight: All Colours

beats.narration: When sunlight hits air molecules, it scatters everywhere. This is Rayleigh scattering.
beats.tts: When sunlight hits air molecules, it scatters everywhere. This is Rayleigh scattering.
beats.heading: Rayleigh Scattering

beats.narration: Blue light scatters 10 times more than red light because it's shorter wavelength.
beats.tts: Blue light scatters 10 times more than red light because it's shorter wavelength.
beats.heading: Why Blue Scatters More

beats.narration: Scattered blue light comes from all directions, so sky looks blue.
beats.tts: Scattered blue light comes from all directions, so sky looks blue.
beats.heading: Why Sky Looks Blue

beats.narration: At sunset, light travels far through air, so blue scatters away and red/orange remains.
beats.tts: At sunset, light travels far through air, so blue scatters away and red/orange remains.
beats.heading: Sunset Magic
